summary:
伊頓 EPS 超預期 2.9%、營收年增 16.8%，盤後大漲 0.92%，38.3 倍本益比合理，電力基礎設施與資料中心配電需求強勁，是本批次最佳工業股之一。
• EPS $2.81 超越預估 $2.73，驚喜幅度 +2.9%，電力管理業務與資料中心配電需求共同驅動業績。
• 單季營收 $74.5 億美元，年增 16.8%，電氣化基礎設施投資浪潮持續拉動訂單。
• 本益比 38.3 倍，市值 $1,520 億美元，對高成長電力管理工業股屬合理估值，AI 電力需求支撐溢價。
• 盤後股價大漲 0.92%，為本批次工業股中最強盤後反應，顯示市場高度認可 AI 基礎設施受惠邏輯。
• 16.8% 年增率在傳統工業股中屬優異，資料中心配電、電氣化交通、能源轉型三大主題形成共振。
ai_view:
伊頓是本批次中工業股的最佳代表——2.9% EPS 驚喜、16.8% 年增率搭配盤後大漲 0.92%，三項指標共同顯示市場對其在 AI/電氣化基礎設施需求中的核心定位高度認可。相較於開拓重工（景氣循環疑慮）、埃克森美孚（油價依賴），伊頓的需求驅動力更具結構性與長期確定性：資料中心不間斷電源（UPS）、配電、電力品質管理是 AI 算力擴張的必要基礎設施，需求能見度高。38.3 倍本益比在此成長背景下屬合理水準。短期而言，財報帶來正面動能；中期而言，若電力網格現代化（grid modernization）政策支持持續且 AI 資料中心建設不減速，伊頓具備繼續上行的空間。需追蹤指標：電氣業務（Electrical Americas、Global）訂單成長率與積壓量、資料中心客戶合約進展、以及航太與工業業務（非電氣）的邊際表現。整體而言，伊頓是本批次中工業股最值得持續關注的標的。

需留意：38.3 倍本益比對工業股屬高溢價，若 AI 資料中心建設節奏放緩，估值修正空間較大。；電力管理設備供應鏈仍面臨變壓器等核心組件供應瓶頸，若交期延誤影響收入確認時程，季度業績可能出現波動。；電氣化需求若因政策轉向（如美國 EV 補貼政策調整）而放緩，部分需求動能將受影響。

summary_en:
Eaton beat EPS by 2.9% with 16.8% YoY revenue growth; a strong +0.92% post-earnings gain and 38.3x P/E reflect robust demand from data center and power infrastructure—one of the standout industrials in this batch.
• EPS of $2.81 beat the $2.73 estimate by 2.9%, driven by electrical segment strength and data center power management demand.
• Revenue of $7.45B grew 16.8% YoY, supported by the ongoing wave of electrification infrastructure investment.
• P/E of 38.3x on a $152B market cap is a reasonable premium for a high-growth electrical management industrial, underpinned by AI power demand.
• Post-earnings stock surged +0.92%—the strongest post-earnings reaction among industrials in this batch—confirming high market confidence in the AI infrastructure thesis.
• 16.8% YoY growth is outstanding for a large-cap industrial; three major demand themes (data center power, transportation electrification, energy transition) are converging.

ai_view_en:
Eaton is the standout industrial in this batch—a 2.9% EPS beat, 16.8% YoY growth, and +0.92% post-earnings surge collectively confirm high market conviction in its AI/electrification infrastructure positioning. Compared to Caterpillar (cycle peak concerns) and Exxon (oil price dependency), Eaton's demand drivers are more structurally durable: data center UPS, power distribution, and power quality management are essential AI compute infrastructure components with high demand visibility. A 38.3x P/E is reasonable in this growth context. Near-term, earnings momentum is positive. Medium-term, if grid modernization policy support continues and AI data center build-out maintains pace, Eaton has room to continue appreciating. Key metrics: Electrical segment (Americas and Global) order growth and backlog, data center customer contract pipeline, and margin performance in aerospace and industrial segments. Eaton is the most consistently attractive industrial name in the current batch for continued monitoring.

Watch：A 38.3x P/E for an industrial stock is a premium; if AI data center construction decelerates, there is meaningful downside from multiple compression.; Power management equipment supply chains still face bottlenecks in key components (transformers); delivery delays could disrupt revenue recognition timing.; Electrification demand could slow if policy tailwinds shift (e.g., changes to US EV subsidies), affecting a portion of the demand narrative.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $2.81 超越預估 $2.73，驚喜幅度 +2.9%，屬正向超預期。
